# "They called it The Game With The Zombies."

"Real creative bunch, ain't they." - Earl

# What You're Getting Into

Endless waves of zombies. One stationary VR shooter. A global leaderboard separating the survivors from  the statistics. Pick up and play in seconds - no  tutorials, no cutscenes, just you and an undead army  with nowhere to be.

# Three Arenas. Zero Mercy.

1. **Power Plant** - A crumbling industrial courtyard. Wide open, nowhere to hide, and Earl has a clear view of every miss.

2. **The Apocalyptic** - A makeshift combat pit ringed by shipping containers and burning torches. Someone put up bunting. It is not a party.

3. **The Colosseum** - An ancient arena built for blood sport. The crowd is gone. The zombies are not. Earl is unmoved.

# Features

- *Endless zombie survival* - Waves keep coming. So does the dread.
- *Global leaderboard* - Prove to the world you outlast strangers.
- *Live sarcastic commentary* - Earl reacts to every miss, kill, and embarrassing death. In real time.
- *Random power-up spawns* - Grab them before the zombies do.
- *Comfortable stationary VR* - No roomscale needed. Just reflexes. Dignity optional.
- *High replayability* - Every run ends. Pride demands you go again.

# Also a Lethal Party Game

The Game With The Zombies is the perfect party game for your next VR night - fast rounds, instant competition, and a sarcastic farmer who will roast your friends even harder than you will. See who tops the leaderboard by end of night. Losers explain themselves to Earl.

# How Long Can YOU Last?
